pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeImportedG: needs a DXF/SVG graphics importer; none exists and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.TableEditor.editTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.PadTool.explodePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
pcbnew.PadTool.recombinePad: needs custom-shape pads (a pad made of graphic primitives); the footprint IR models only the six standard pad shapes
